title: Working-memory load decoding
disposition_reason: The source implements full held-patient load prediction,training-only adaptive investigation,matched references and independent scoring. Authentic roster,clinical/preprocessing decisions,provider/profile and complete qualification remain external and unissued; a source-complete predictor is not an executed or scientifically qualified benchmark.

scientific_target.question: Do equal-duration maintenance LFP and/or spike observations predict low versus high memory load in entirely held patients beyond modality availability,rate and power comparators?
scientific_target.known_answer: Original trial load:low=1 versus high=3; submit one p_high for every eligible original maintenance interval.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Evaluator-only NWB trial load metadata,joined to the original interval and authenticated patient/session provenance. The labels are task conditions,not PAC significance or correctness labels.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held-patient episode containing every eligible trial from all that patient sessions; predictions are per original2.5s maintenance interval.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Patient; declared36 people with44 sessions,not channels,trials or sessions as independent participants.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Cross-patient memory-load classification from a specified retrospective maintenance window. Source preprocessing can share spike/LFP information and may have acausal temporal support; crop timing alone does not prove online causal access.
exclusions: No PAC/coupling result from decoder accuracy.
No clinical diagnostic or causal maintenance mechanism claim.
No native no-tools understanding from adaptive Python strategy hooks or programme scores.

inputs: Per-trial LFP arrays in volts with1000 samples at400Hz over[maintenance,maintenance+2.5s),plus area indices.
Relative spike times in[0,2.5s),ragged unit offsets and region indices; five source regions are hippocampus,amygdala,preSMA,dACC,vmPFC.
Training views add only training load labels and opaque patient groups; prediction views contain frozen model state and query epochs without targets.
forbidden_inputs: Original patient/session identifiers,trial order,absolute clocks,load,correctness,PicIDs,probe/phase fields,encoding counts and source event files in query views.
PAC significance,category selectivity,correctness or firing-rate selection used to define decoder eligibility.
Query-based normalization/calibration/refitting or access to held labels; undeclared post-probe signal support.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source-private identity binds patient/session/original trial. Public IDs are keyed32-hex tokens,with normalized timestamps and opaque-ID ordering. Exact authentic roster and emitted IDs are external and unissued.
observation_contract.split: Implemented outer leave-one-patient-out and inner whole-patient tuning; all sessions of each patient stay grouped. Fit/investigation capsules access training patients only; frozen query prediction follows.
observation_contract.coverage: Source declaration is44 sessions/36 patients/140 trials per session with70 per load before eligibility. Every asset/trial requires disposition; patients lacking eligible trials or both classes fail complete qualification. Six mode/arm cells and five references per patient are conditions,not additional benchmarks.

primary.name: Patient-macro balanced accuracy at p_high>=0.5
primary.aggregation: Pool eligible trials across sessions within each patient,compute two-class balanced accuracy,then equal mean over all expected patients. No unsupported patient/class is silently deleted.
primary.rationale: Measures recovery of withheld memory-load labels across people while avoiding large-session/patient dominance.

secondary: Patient-macro binary log loss with1e-15 clipping; report full per-patient class denominators.
Paired differences against availability-only,rate-only,power-only and combined references.
Independent scalar recomputation of aggregate metrics to1e-12 and complete actor/source/model/prediction lineage.

comparators.name: Patient-weighted class prior
comparators.procedure: Implemented equal-total-patient-weight prior; no neural signal.

comparators.name: Availability-only logistic reference
comparators.inputs: Eligible LFP channel and spike-unit counts by region
comparators.procedure: Implemented nuisance diagnostic with train-only missing indicators/imputation/scaling and nested whole-patient C selection; must not be called neural competence.

comparators.name: Rate-only,power-only and combined logistic references
comparators.inputs: Per-area log1p spike rates and/or fixed Welch log-band-power summaries from allowed epochs
comparators.procedure: Implemented train-only robust transforms,patient weights,inner equal-patient log-loss selection over C=.01,.1,1,10,100; convergence required,all folds retained.

nuisance_controls: Keep all prospectively eligible regions/modalities; no hippocampus-only or PAC-derived selected cohort.
Modality-element artifacts may remove an element while retaining the trial if another allowed modality remains; availability-only comparison tests resulting clinical/missingness confounding.
Hide trial order and mapping cues,including the source-declared mapping reversal after trial70.
Authenticate upstream spike interpolation/filtering/clock support; LFP and spike combination is not independent-modality biological evidence.
Group patient sessions and fit every transform/calibration using outer-training people only.
evaluation.uncertainty: Prospective paired10000-resample patient bootstrap uses frozen cross-validated predictions and one draw bank. It omits refitting variation and has overlapping-training limitations; report patient differences and descriptive uncertainty without trial/channel pseudoreplication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact complete eligible trial-ID coverage and finite p_high in[0,1]required. Missing/single-class patients,missing source assets,nonconverged references or target barrier failures invalidate complete qualification; keep every exclusion and failed cell visible.

implementation.scorer_target: score.score_cell scores authentic held-trial load labels as patient-macro balanced accuracy and log loss; this is a genuine neural-to-behavioral-condition prediction target,not the source paper PAC analysis.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete proposed preparation,training-only fit/adaptation,source-matched reference and target-last scoring source for the existing decoder endpoint; external authentic inputs and provider qualification are absent. Training-only investigative recipe construction is preserved as a programme condition; it does not supply per-query tool-assisted interpretation.
missing: Authenticated full roster/identity key,per-element clinical/artifact/preprocessing decisions and observed eligible class support.
Whole-source source-clock/filter support qualification,provider/native profile and actual resource measurement.
Authentic reference competence,independent numerical verification and participant model trials.
implementation.execution_evidence: Retained SCIENCE contract explicitly records no scientific run,acquired cohort,qualified reference or active execution. This revision adds no empirical result; schema/strategy code is not model reasoning evidence.

direct_observation.representation: No-tools interpretation could use faithfully rendered/summarized maintenance neural observations under a separately frozen representation. Existing epoch arrays are input data for numeric actors,not a delivered direct observer.
direct_observation.boundary: Do not expose load/order/probe metadata; preserve the same complete query target and calibration allocation.
missing: Direct representation and response collection have not been implemented.

typed_viewer.representation: No typed LFP/spike viewer exists for this task. Any future viewer must retain relevant timing and region information without leaking original trial labels.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed actions only,no hidden labels/extra metadata/raw-array shortcuts; fixed action budget.
missing: Task-specific rendering/transport and full answer coverage.

tool_assisted.representation: No per-query tool-assisted investigation is delivered. Existing case-adaptive source investigates training-patient observations only and freezes its recipe before held-patient prediction.
tool_assisted.boundary: Worker investigate uses TrainingAPI without query access; held-patient queries execute only the sealed module.predict path. This is training-stage method construction, not held-observation investigation.
missing: Qualified provider/model identity/call accounting and authentic model execution remain absent.
A participant-facing investigation episode with permitted held-query observations and bounded tool actions is not implemented.

frozen_program.representation: Source implements fixed candidate programmes and training-only adaptive recipe construction, followed by frozen held-patient prediction. Five fixed references are separate comparators.
frozen_program.boundary: Method and adaptation recipe bound before study; target barrier closes all outputs before protected scoring.
missing: External roster/profile,authentic checks and active isolated execution remain unissued.

Specified true target/units,complete patient grouping,availability-only nuisance comparison and upstream temporal-support limitation.
Made training-only adaptive investigation distinct from query-driven adaptation and absent direct/viewer delivery.

Classify training-only recipe investigation under programme construction; per-query tool-assisted mode is not delivered, consistently with NEURAL-053/056/057.
